mapper.insert: insert into course_environment_request ( course_name, teacher_user_id, class_name, use_time, lab_type, software_requirements, system_requirements, special_requirements, process_status, assigned_lab_id, confirm_status ) values ( coalesce(nullif(#{courseName}, ''), nullif(#{course}, ''), '新课程环境'), coalesce(#{teacherUserId}, 3), coalesce(nullif(#{className}, ''), '待填写班级'), coalesce(nullif(#{useTime}, ''), '待确认'), coalesce(nullif(#{labType}, ''), '计算机实验室'), coalesce(nullif(#{softwareRequirements}, ''), nullif(#{software}, '')), #{systemRequirements}, #{specialRequirements}, coalesce(nullif(#{processStatus}, ''), nullif(#{status}, ''), '待配置'), #{assignedLabId}, coalesce(nullif(#{confirmStatus}, ''), '待确认') )
mapper.update: update course_environment_request set confirm_status = '已确认', process_status = '已确认', updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update course_environment_request set course_name = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.courseName}, ''), nullif(#{courseEnvironment.course}, ''), course_name), teacher_user_id = coalesce(#{courseEnvironment.teacherUserId}, teacher_user_id), class_name = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.className}, ''), class_name), use_time = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.useTime}, ''), use_time), lab_type = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.labType}, ''), lab_type), software_requirements = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.softwareRequirements}, ''), nullif(#{courseEnvironment.software}, ''), software_requirements), system_requirements = coalesce(#{courseEnvironment.systemRequirements}, system_requirements), special_requirements = coalesce(#{courseEnvironment.specialRequirements}, special_requirements), process_status = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.processStatus}, ''), nullif(#{courseEnvironment.status}, ''), process_status), assigned_lab_id = coalesce(#{courseEnvironment.assignedLabId}, assigned_lab_id), confirm_status = coalesce(nullif(#{courseEnvironment.confirmStatus}, ''), confirm_status), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select cer.id, cer.course_name as courseName, cer.course_name as course, cer.teacher_user_id as teacherUserId, u.real_name as teacherName, coalesce(u.real_name, cast(cer.teacher_user_id as char)) as teacher, u.username as teacherUsername, cer.class_name as className, cer.use_time as useTime, cer.lab_type as labType, cer.software_requirements as softwareRequirements, cer.software_requirements as software, cer.system_requirements as systemRequirements, cer.special_requirements as specialRequirements, cer.process_status as processStatus, cer.process_status as status, cer.assigned_lab_id as assignedLabId, l.lab_name as assignedLabName, l.lab_code as assignedLabCode, cer.confirm_status as confirmStatus, case when cer.process_status = '已确认' or cer.confirm_status = '已确认' then 'success' when cer.process_status = '配置中' then 'primary' when cer.process_status = '已退回' then 'danger' else 'warning' end as tagType, cer.created_at as createdAt, cer.updated_at as updatedAt from course_environment_request cer left join sys_user u on u.id = cer.teacher_user_id left join lab l on l.id = cer.assigned_lab_id order by cer.id desc

select cer.id, cer.course_name as courseName, cer.course_name as course, cer.teacher_user_id as teacherUserId, u.real_name as teacherName, coalesce(u.real_name, cast(cer.teacher_user_id as char)) as teacher, u.username as teacherUsername, cer.class_name as className, cer.use_time as useTime, cer.lab_type as labType, cer.software_requirements as softwareRequirements, cer.software_requirements as software, cer.system_requirements as systemRequirements, cer.special_requirements as specialRequirements, cer.process_status as processStatus, cer.process_status as status, cer.assigned_lab_id as assignedLabId, l.lab_name as assignedLabName, l.lab_code as assignedLabCode, cer.confirm_status as confirmStatus, case when cer.process_status = '已确认' or cer.confirm_status = '已确认' then 'success' when cer.process_status = '配置中' then 'primary' when cer.process_status = '已退回' then 'danger' else 'warning' end as tagType, cer.created_at as createdAt, cer.updated_at as updatedAt from course_environment_request cer left join sys_user u on u.id = cer.teacher_user_id left join lab l on l.id = cer.assigned_lab_id where cer.id = #{id}
